recipes.title: Spiced Peanut Butter Toast
recipes.description: A quick 5-minute breakfast that packs a flavor punch.
steps: Toast two slices of your favorite bread until golden.
Spread a generous layer of Bharat ka Spiced Peanut Butter.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle chopped nuts.
